LESSON 41 / ADDITIONAL INTERVIEW CONCEPT
Image lazy loading and intrinsic dimensions

loading="lazy" may defer off-screen image loading. width and height reserve an aspect ratio to
reduce layout shifts. Important above-the-fold images generally should not be lazy-loaded.
loading="lazy" එJකෙන් පෙහල තිJයෙන images load කිරීම පේ‍රමාදෙ කෙරන්න පුළුවන්. width සහ height දුන්නම image එකෙට ඉඩ Jවන් Jවනවා. පේ‍රධාන hero image එකෙ lazy-load කිරීම සාමාන්‍යJයෙන් Jහාඳ නුහු.
A catalog loads product photos as the user scrolls.
Catalog viewport · Hero image: load normally · Below the fold · Lazy image Reserved space

Read the diagram: The visible hero loads normally. Off-screen images can load near the viewport,
and their declared dimensions reserve space. The browser decides the exact loading threshold.
Expected result: The product image may load later; dimensions reserve its aspect ratio.
Interview question: Why specify image dimensions?
Answer: They help browsers reserve space and reduce unexpected layout shifts.
Remember: Lazy = defer off-screen; dimensions = reserve space.
Practice: Add lazy loading to a long product listing.
